item.title: SongWave 0.5.4
item.description:
- **Visible Settings:** a labeled button and Command-comma open General, Playback Access, Effects, Updates and Help. Everyday keyboard/volume toggles stay visible in the player. - **Interface refinement:** clearer SF Pro hierarchy, stronger content contrast, native glass controls, consistent spacing and a clearer listening/haptics distinction. - **Precision editing:** numeric fields focus on open and explain invalid entries without dismissing them. - **In-app updates:** automatic checks with approval before installation. Signed release information and downloads; a manual check in the SongWave menu and Settings → Updates. - **Calls when using song links:** explicit Spotify/Music routes pause for recognized active calls, release capture, and reconnect afterward. An idle FaceTime app does not pause music. - **Smoother bypass:** switching speaker-mode haptics off uses a short fade. Stop, recognized calls and capture errors still stop output immediately. - **Access recovery:** saved setup and the latest audio-access check are separate. Failed checks offer Retry and prevent automatic continuation until a successful check. - **Tuning help:** Transient emphasis explains what higher settings feel like. - **Pattern validation:** AHAP numeric fields reject Boolean values.
People on 0.5.3 need to install 0.5.4 manually once. Later signed releases can arrive through the app. An ordinary code push does not publish an update.
